callouts.title: String labels
callouts.text: One lane per string. The rows above hold tones, sections, phrases and measures.
callouts.name: TimelineGutter

callouts.title: Timeline
callouts.text: The chart: notes as numbered gems on their string, hand shapes and hand positions under them, the red playhead.
callouts.name: MainChartRenderer

callouts.title: Song map
callouts.text: The whole song with its sections. Click to jump.
callouts.name: MinimapOverview

callouts.title: Inspector
callouts.text: Everything about the selection, in tabs. See below.
callouts.name: InspectorRoot

callouts.title: 3D preview
callouts.text: The highway as a player sees it, at the playhead.
callouts.name: Preview3DPane

callouts.title: Edit readouts
callouts.text: Grid snap, how many sounds are selected, and the zoom.
callouts.name: StatusEditReadoutsSlot

callouts.title: Transport
callouts.text: Play, pause and stop. Space plays and pauses.

callouts.title: Grid snap
callouts.text: How finely each beat is divided when you place or move notes. T marks triplet grids.

callouts.title: Edit
callouts.text: Undo, redo and save. Hover undo to see the history.

callouts.title: Zoom
callouts.text: Zooms the timeline. Ctrl+wheel does the same.

callouts.title: Follow playhead
callouts.text: Keeps the view on the playhead. Panning turns it off.

callouts.title: Mix
callouts.text: Song, input and metronome levels.
callouts.name: MixFlyoutButton

callouts.title: Tempo
callouts.text: Playback speed, and the drop-tune pedal.
callouts.name: TempoFlyoutButton

callouts.title: Tools
callouts.text: Tuner, MIDI instrument and live effects.
callouts.name: ToolsFlyoutButton

callouts.title: Tracks
callouts.text: The active arrangement and level, other arrangements as ghosts, and the vocal track.
callouts.name: TracksFlyoutButton

callouts.title: Play the chart
callouts.text: Plays the charted notes as a synth, to check them by ear.
callouts.name: ChartSynthToolbarToggle

callouts.title: Loop
callouts.text: Loops the marked region.
callouts.name: LoopToolbarToggle

callouts.title: AI chat
callouts.text: Shows the AI chat panel.
callouts.name: ToolbarAiChatToggle

callouts.title: New project
callouts.text: Starts a project from an audio file, with title, artist and tuning.

callouts.title: Open project
callouts.text: Opens a saved DotCharter project.

callouts.title: Open recent
callouts.text: The projects you opened last.

callouts.title: Save project
callouts.text: Saves the project (Ctrl+S).

callouts.title: Save project as
callouts.text: Saves a copy under a new name or folder.

callouts.title: Attach audio
callouts.text: Copies an audio file into the project folder and uses it as the song's audio.

callouts.title: Chart from audio
callouts.text: Detects beats and notes in the audio and writes a draft chart for you to correct.

callouts.title: Import
callouts.text: Brings in a chart from another format. See the Import submenu below.

callouts.title: Export
callouts.text: Writes the chart to other formats. See the Export submenu below.

callouts.title: Play mode
callouts.text: Switches to Play Mode to play the song like a game.

callouts.title: Reveal project
callouts.text: Opens the project folder in File Explorer.

callouts.title: Song metadata
callouts.text: Title, artist, album, year and the other song details.

callouts.title: Settings
callouts.text: Opens the settings.

callouts.title: Exit
callouts.text: Closes DotCharter and asks about unsaved changes first.

callouts.title: Guitar Pro
callouts.text: Imports a Guitar Pro file as arrangements, with tempo and sections.

callouts.title: Editor on Fire
callouts.text: Creates a project from an Editor on Fire project file.

callouts.title: Rocksmith XML
callouts.text: Imports an arrangement from a Rocksmith arrangement XML file into the open project.

callouts.title: MIDI file
callouts.text: Imports notes from a MIDI file.

callouts.title: Audio from YouTube
callouts.text: Downloads a video's audio and attaches it to the open project.

callouts.title: Rocksmith package
callouts.text: Builds a custom-song package of the chart, with every arrangement, for the game.

callouts.title: DotCharter song
callouts.text: Packs the project, audio included, into one song file to share.

callouts.title: Guitar Pro
callouts.text: Writes the chart as a Guitar Pro file.

callouts.title: Editor on Fire
callouts.text: Writes an Editor on Fire project.

callouts.title: Sheet music PDF
callouts.text: Prints the chart as notation and tab to a PDF.

callouts.title: Undo
callouts.text: Takes back the last edit (Ctrl+Z).

callouts.title: Redo
callouts.text: Repeats an undone edit.

callouts.title: History
callouts.text: The list of edits; jump back to any of them.

callouts.title: Checkpoints
callouts.text: Named snapshots of the project you can return to.

callouts.title: Cut
callouts.text: Cuts the selection.

callouts.title: Copy
callouts.text: Copies the selection.

callouts.title: Paste
callouts.text: Pastes at the playhead.

callouts.title: Paste special
callouts.text: Chooses what to paste: notes, hand shapes, positions and more.

callouts.title: Select all
callouts.text: Selects every note and chord of the arrangement.

callouts.title: Select same pattern
callouts.text: Selects every repeat of the selected pattern.

callouts.title: Delete selected
callouts.text: Deletes the selection.

callouts.title: Pattern builder
callouts.text: Builds a repeating pattern of notes and fills a range with it.

callouts.title: Snap & length
callouts.text: Snaps notes to the grid and changes their length. See below.

callouts.title: Bookmarks
callouts.text: Ten bookmarks: set one at the playhead and jump back to it.

callouts.title: Snap selected
callouts.text: Moves the selected notes onto the nearest grid line.

callouts.title: Snap all
callouts.text: Snaps every note of the arrangement.

callouts.title: Increase length
callouts.text: Makes the selected sustains one grid step longer.

callouts.title: Decrease length
callouts.text: Makes them one grid step shorter.

callouts.title: Start & end
callouts.text: Adds silence or measures before the first or after the last beat. See below.

callouts.title: Insert beat
callouts.text: Adds a beat at the playhead.

callouts.title: Remove beat
callouts.text: Removes the beat at the playhead.

callouts.title: Set BPM
callouts.text: Sets one tempo for every measure.

callouts.title: Align beat grid
callouts.text: Moves the beat grid so it lines up with the charted notes.

callouts.title: Align to recording
callouts.text: Fits the beat map to the audio's own beats.

callouts.title: Lock beat map
callouts.text: Protects the beats from being moved by accident.

callouts.title: Default start silence
callouts.text: Sets the standard lead-in before the first beat.

callouts.title: Silence at beginning
callouts.text: Adds silence before the song starts.

callouts.title: Measures at start
callouts.text: Adds empty measures before the first beat.

callouts.title: Silence at end
callouts.text: Adds silence after the song.

callouts.title: Measures at end
callouts.text: Adds empty measures after the last beat.

callouts.title: New arrangement
callouts.text: Adds a lead, rhythm, bass or other path to the song.

callouts.title: Delete arrangement
callouts.text: Removes the active arrangement.

callouts.title: Copy sections & phrases
callouts.text: Copies this arrangement's section and phrase markers to every other one.

callouts.title: Apply edits to another
callouts.text: Copies hand positions, fingerings and hand shapes where two arrangements play the same notes.

callouts.title: Arrangement settings
callouts.text: Name, type, tuning, capo and string count.

callouts.title: New vocal track
callouts.text: Adds a lyrics track.

callouts.title: Delete vocal track
callouts.text: Removes the active vocal track.

callouts.title: Insert vocal
callouts.text: Adds a placeholder syllable at the playhead.

callouts.title: Vocal track settings
callouts.text: Name and options of the vocal track.

callouts.title: Fret hand positions
callouts.text: Generates the hand positions the highway shows.

callouts.title: Hand shapes
callouts.text: Creates chord and arpeggio hand shapes.

callouts.title: Chords
callouts.text: Turns notes into chords and back, and switches fingerings.

callouts.title: Fix & clean up
callouts.text: Repairs and polishes a chart, optionally with AI help.

callouts.title: Structure & levels
callouts.text: Phrases, sections and difficulty levels.

callouts.title: Tone & sound
callouts.text: Tuner, tone designer, rig and stem separation.

callouts.title: Showlights editor
callouts.text: Edits the stage lights that play with the song in the 3D view.

callouts.title: Screenshot highway
callouts.text: Saves a picture of the 3D highway.

callouts.title: Review
callouts.text: Quality report, comparison and library-wide checks.

callouts.title: Generate FHP
callouts.text: Places fret-hand positions over the whole arrangement.

callouts.title: For selection
callouts.text: Does the same for the selected notes only.

callouts.title: From selection
callouts.text: Makes a chord hand shape over the selected notes.

callouts.title: Arpeggio
callouts.text: Makes an arpeggio hand shape over the selected notes.

callouts.title: Whole arrangement
callouts.text: Generates hand shapes for every chord.

callouts.title: Accept suggestions
callouts.text: Turns the dashed suggested shapes in the selection into real ones.

callouts.title: Accept as arpeggios
callouts.text: The same, as arpeggio shapes.

callouts.title: Apply template
callouts.text: Applies a hand shape's chord template to the selected chords.

callouts.title: Power chord (small)
callouts.text: Turns a note into a two-string power chord.

callouts.title: Power chord (big)
callouts.text: Turns a note into a three-string power chord.

callouts.title: Merge into chord
callouts.text: Joins notes at the same time into one chord.

callouts.title: Split into notes
callouts.text: Breaks a chord into single notes.

callouts.title: Octave fingering
callouts.text: Switches octave shapes between fingers 1-3 and 1-4.

callouts.title: Power chord fingering
callouts.text: Switches power chords between fingers 1-3 and 1-4.

callouts.title: Muted strums
callouts.text: Turns muted strums into a muted chord.

callouts.title: Ghost gems
callouts.text: Marks notes as held in the chord box but not played.

callouts.title: Tapped harmonic
callouts.text: Makes the selected notes tapped harmonics.

callouts.title: Improve chart
callouts.text: Polishes a valid chart: trims it to the audio, adds the END phrase and restates hand positions.

callouts.title: Auto-fix
callouts.text: Repairs what is broken: order, duplicates, lengths, slides and anchors.

callouts.title: Remove double-stop names
callouts.text: Clears chord names from two-string shapes.

callouts.title: Optimize fretting
callouts.text: Moves notes to other strings to reduce hand movement.

callouts.title: Fix FHP & fingering with AI
callouts.text: Asks the AI provider from Settings to correct hand positions, fingerings, or both.

callouts.title: Fix chord names with AI
callouts.text: Corrects chord names in Editor on Fire spelling.

callouts.title: Musical chord names
callouts.text: The same, in musical spelling.

callouts.title: AI settings
callouts.text: Picks the AI provider and model.

callouts.title: Generate structure
callouts.text: Adds the COUNT and END phrases and no-guitar sections over silences.

callouts.title: Propagate phrase
callouts.text: Copies the phrase under the playhead to every repeat of it.

callouts.title: Generate levels
callouts.text: Builds easier difficulty levels from the hardest one.

callouts.title: Squash levels
callouts.text: Merges the levels back into one.

callouts.title: Tuner
callouts.text: Tunes your instrument to the arrangement's tuning.

callouts.title: Tone designer
callouts.text: Edits the tones the song switches between.

callouts.title: Rig
callouts.text: Opens the tone rig.

callouts.title: Generate tones with AI
callouts.text: Asks your AI provider for one tone per tone change.

callouts.title: Separate stems
callouts.text: Splits the audio into guitar, bass, drums and vocals, so you can mute your part.

callouts.title: Chart quality report
callouts.text: Every check in one list, with Go to and Fix for each finding.

callouts.title: Compare with project file
callouts.text: Shows what differs between the open chart and a saved one.

callouts.title: Lint chart library
callouts.text: Checks every project in a folder and can fix them.

callouts.title: Panels
callouts.text: Shows or hides the editor's panels. See below.

callouts.title: Rows
callouts.text: Shows or hides the rows above the strings. See below.

callouts.title: Show waveform
callouts.text: Draws the audio waveform behind the notes.

callouts.title: Show song map
callouts.text: The overview strip of the whole song under the timeline.

callouts.title: Suggested hand shapes
callouts.text: Shows dashed hand-shape suggestions.

callouts.title: Zoom in
callouts.text: Stretches the timeline.

callouts.title: Zoom out
callouts.text: Shows more of the song.

callouts.title: Float chart timeline
callouts.text: Moves the timeline into its own window.

callouts.title: Reset layout
callouts.text: Puts every panel back where it started.

callouts.title: Inspector
callouts.text: Properties of the selection.

callouts.title: 3D preview
callouts.text: The highway as a player sees it.

callouts.title: Sheet music
callouts.text: Notation and tab under the timeline.

callouts.title: AI chat
callouts.text: Ask an AI assistant about fingering, hand positions and sections.

callouts.title: Stem mixer
callouts.text: Levels of the separated stems.

callouts.title: Stacked tracks
callouts.text: The other arrangements, stacked under this one.

callouts.title: Riff library
callouts.text: Saved riffs to drop back into a chart.

callouts.title: Sections
callouts.text: The section row (intro, verse, chorus...).

callouts.title: Phrases
callouts.text: The phrase row.

callouts.title: Lyrics
callouts.text: The lyrics row.

callouts.title: Tones
callouts.text: The tone-change row.

callouts.title: Measure info
callouts.text: Measure numbers, tempo and time signature.

callouts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
callouts.text: Every shortcut, searchable.

callouts.title: About
callouts.text: Version and credits.

callouts.title: License & notices
callouts.text: The licence and third-party notices.

callouts.title: Check for updates
callouts.text: Looks for a newer release.

callouts.title: Usage statistics
callouts.text: Writes a local report of the commands you use. Nothing is uploaded.

callouts.title: Session health
callouts.text: Rendering and audio diagnostics, and a bundle to attach to a bug report.

callouts.title: Sound
callouts.text: The selected note, chord or hand shape: string, fret, length, techniques and bends.

callouts.title: Mixer
callouts.text: Volume, effects, EQ and the MIDI instrument.

callouts.title: Song
callouts.text: Key signature, and renaming tones, sections and phrases everywhere at once.

callouts.title: Lyrics
callouts.text: Paste lyrics, then tap each syllable with Ctrl+Space while the song plays.

callouts.title: Issues
callouts.text: Everything the checker found, export blockers first. Click one to jump to it.

callouts.title: Notes
callouts.text: Reminders and marks pinned to the timeline.

callouts.title: Phrases
callouts.text: Every phrase and its repeats; copy one repeat to all others.

callouts.title: Riff library
callouts.text: Riffs you saved, ready to drop back in.

callouts.title: Chord shapes
callouts.text: Every chord shape of the arrangement, where it is used, and which lack a fingering.

callouts.title: Selection
callouts.text: What is selected, its position among all sounds, and arrows to step through them.
callouts.name: SoundNavRow

callouts.title: Sections
callouts.text: Placement, Techniques, Bends and Findings (what the checker found about this note). Click one to jump to it.
callouts.name: SoundRail

callouts.title: String
callouts.text: Moves the note to another string; Fret sets the fret below it.
callouts.name: NoteStringPicker

callouts.title: Length
callouts.text: The sustain, in grid steps. Slide to sets where a slide ends.
callouts.name: NoteLengthSpinner

callouts.title: Shape
callouts.text: The chord's frets, name and fingering.
callouts.name: SoundRailShapeEntry

callouts.title: Name
callouts.text: The chord name the player sees.
callouts.name: NamingBlock

callouts.title: Fingering
callouts.text: Which finger holds each string.
callouts.name: FingeringBlock

callouts.title: Apply to
callouts.text: Applies the shape to the same chord elsewhere.
callouts.name: SoundApplyRow
